entities.title: A record in LodeStar's own format
entities.summary: Saves are LodeStar text records with the baseline's accept and reject behaviour, not the baseline's files.
entities.context: The baseline's record format is the original's; only its accept and reject behaviour matters to play.
entities.decision: A text record with a version header, one line per field and a CRC-32 check over the canonical text (RULES A.8.4 allows any check with the same effect).
entities.rationale: Readable and safe to import, and nothing of the original's format is copied (deliberate difference 11).
